name: Nathan's AI
summary: Portfolio reimagined as an AI chat: visitors ask questions about Nathan Brodin instead of browsing pages.
description: A portfolio presented as a conversational AI chatbot: visitors ask about Nathan Brodin's career, skills, projects and experience. Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and the Vercel AI SDK (Anthropic by default), with chat history in Postgres and rate limiting via Upstash. The MIT-licensed repo documents how to deploy or rebrand your own version.
contains: chat interface that answers questions about career, skills, projects and experience
Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and the Vercel AI SDK (Anthropic default)
chat history saved in Vercel Postgres (Neon); Upstash rate limiting
